# Abiegnus Base Camp

> Studies in service to the A∴A∴ Student College & beyond

Abiegnus Base Camp is a study resource for aspirants in the Student grade of the A∴A∴ (Astrum Argentum), operated in service to the A∴A∴ Student College. It provides coursework, reading materials, and assignment prompts to prepare students for grade work in the A∴A∴ system of Western esoteric initiation.

## Pages

- [Home](https://abiegnusbasecamp.org/): Introduction and index of available coursework.
- [Prospectus](https://abiegnusbasecamp.org/prospectus/): Overview of the Student grade task — obtaining a general intellectual knowledge of all systems of attainment — and the course of assisted independent study covering the humanities, sciences, world religions, art theory, and philosophical roots of magical practice.
- [Module 1.0: The Magick Mirror](https://abiegnusbasecamp.org/aasc-module-1-0-the-magick-mirror/): The first assignment. An autobiographical essay covering the student's background, formative influences, magical and religious history, and statement of intent in undertaking the Great Work.
